milestone.name: K7.8 - Event Assimilation Layer
milestone.summary: Freeze how new events affect Julia current understanding through observation, meaning, proposal, and governance without mutating identity.

acceptance_targets: Event Assimilation defines Event Observation, Event Meaning Representation, and Assimilation Proposal.
Event Observation records what happened without interpreting identity.
Event Meaning Representation captures why the event matters for current understanding.
Assimilation Proposal separates meaning from mutation.
Event Assimilation can affect current reasoning/context.
Event Assimilation cannot directly mutate Identity.
Event Assimilation cannot directly mutate Relationship.
Event Assimilation cannot directly write Memory.
Event Assimilation cannot directly update Experience except through governed proposal.
Event Overreach Detection rejects identity-changing or relationship-changing events without governance.
Event conflicts produce conflict analysis, not automatic adoption.
K7.8 output is provider/context input only; it is not a final response generator.

metrics.EAQS: Observation Accuracy + Meaning Relevance + Impact Boundary Correctness + Governance Routing Correctness - Overreach Risk
metrics.TSR: perceived discontinuity before re-entry - perceived discontinuity after re-entry
